desc: The CZ 600+ RANGE is a precision bolt-action rifle built for sport shooting and medium to long-range hunting. Each rifle is factory tested and guaranteed to deliver sub-0.75 MOA five-shot groups at 100 meters with match-grade ammunition. It features a steel receiver compatible with Remington 700-style optics mounts and a laminated wood stock designed for stability and comfort, complete with a tool-free adjustable cheekpiece and a forend shaped for cooling and control. At its core is a heavy, cold hammer-forged barrel tailored to its caliber, threaded at the muzzle for use with brakes or suppressors. The rifle is equipped with a user-adjustable single-stage trigger offering four pull-weight settings, along with CZ’s patented controlled feed system and a silent ergonomic safety for reliable operation in any position. A magazine lock option allows either removable or fixed-feed use, while a spring-loaded bolt release ensures safe disassembly without touching the trigger.
